abstract: The Lightcast Global AI Skills Outlook examines the worldwide demand for artificial intelligence skills, revealing that AI competency has become a critical priority across industries and geographies, not limited to tech hubs. The United States leads globally in AI skills demand, with San Francisco experiencing the highest average technology sector salaries at $177,636, indicating intense competition for AI talent in major markets.
keyFindings: AI skills are becoming a universal priority beyond Silicon Valley, indicating widespread adoption across industries and regions.
The U.S. leads in AI skills demand relative to other countries globally.
San Francisco commands the highest average tech salary at $177,636, reflecting concentrated demand for AI talent in this market.
methodology: Not specified. The excerpt does not describe the study design, data sources, sample size, time period, or analytical approach used to generate these findings.
